title: 第11章 蝴蝶效应闻太师回朝歌第12章 收服袁福通
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第11章蝴蝶效应，闻太师回朝歌！“是，大王！”
在得到帝辛的应允之后，东海龙王自是没有任何异议。
仔细一想，
四海龙王在朝歌被人供奉，下面龙子龙孙被洪荒人族供奉，除却吸收灵气修炼外，还能修功德，让龙族众龙修炼一路顺风。
到时候只要保证洪荒风调雨顺，那龙族的实力，也就会越来越强！
两全……
不，
三全齐美！
这时，东海龙王低声道：“大王，四海龙族和人族结盟，归于洪荒人道倒是没什么，只是老龙这么做，不会给大王、给人族带来什么祸事吧？”
“哈哈哈……”
听到老龙王的话后，帝辛忽然仰天大笑起来——
“孤王说过：普天之下，莫非皇土；率土之滨，莫非皇臣，孤王是洪荒之主，孤王管理洪荒，跟他昊天有什么关系，他要是敢来，孤王既然敢对女娲挥剑，自然也敢对昊天挥剑！”
轰隆！
咔嚓！
随着帝辛的声音响起，九天惊雷瞬间划破苍穹，无数洪荒大能震惊的目光，齐刷刷地看向朝歌的方向！
而此时，
东海龙王彻底臣服在帝辛的霸道之下，垂首抱拳，心悦诚服道：“人皇大德，堪比上古三皇，老龙对人道发誓：只要老龙活着一天，就唯人皇马首是瞻！”
“好！”
帝辛听后大喜道：“不过现在洪荒水患、旱灾频频，接下来的一段日子里，就要辛苦龙王了！”
“人皇放心，老龙必不辱命！”

龙王留下十个字后，手持人皇诏迅速离开朝歌，直奔陈塘关而去。
它没忘记，那里还有个手持赶山鞭的黄飞虎！
一天后，
黄飞虎得命自陈塘关返回朝歌，而东海龙王则急匆匆返回东海。
“大哥，发生了什么事？我们的修为怎么会忽然暴涨？”
“是啊大哥，还有就是我龙族，背负了两个量劫的杀劫恶果，竟然被无上气运抵消了一半左右，怎么回事？”
“大哥，难道是天庭知道人皇要让我等臣服，所以出手了？！”
……
刚刚回到东海，西、南、北三海龙王，就把东海龙王给围住了，你一言我一语的，想知道发生了什么事。
“哈哈，事情不是你们想的那样！”
看到三大龙王都要急眼了，东海龙王这才哈哈一笑，大声说道：“是我代表龙族，和洪荒人族结盟了，同时答应四海并入洪荒板块，归人皇管辖！”
轰！
听到东海龙王的话后，西、南、北三海的龙王全都愣住了，
过了好一会儿，西海龙王才从震惊中清醒过来，结结巴巴地问道：“大哥，到底是怎么回事？”
“是这样的，我先去了陈塘关见了大商武成王，发现叽里咕噜……你们不知道，当时我看到人族人皇周身笼罩的人道之力后，差点被压得显出原型，那种场景，我只在圣人身上见过！”
东海龙王将朝歌一行，详细地说给自己三个弟弟听，之后又狠狠的吹捧了一下帝辛。
而这时，
西、南、北三海龙王，再度被震惊的说不出话来！
就在这时，
一道极其微弱，但却让四海龙王血脉中生出恐惧的气息，忽然将它们笼罩，紧接着一道微弱无比的声音在他们耳边响起——

Chapter 11 The butterfly effect, hearing the Grand Master’s return song! "Yes, Your Majesty!"
After receiving Di Xin's consent, the Dragon King of East China Sea had no objections.
Think about it carefully,
The Dragon King of the Four Seas was enshrined in Chaoge, and the dragon sons and grandsons below were enshrined by the ancient human race. In addition to absorbing spiritual energy for cultivation, they could also cultivate merits, so that the dragons of the dragon tribe would have a smooth journey in cultivation.
At that time, as long as the prehistoric times are guaranteed to be smooth, the strength of the Dragon Clan will become stronger and stronger!
The best of both worlds...
no
The best of all three!
At this time, the Dragon King of the East China Sea said in a low voice: "Your Majesty, the Dragon Clan of the Four Seas has formed an alliance with the human race, and it is nothing to return to the primitive humanity. But if the old dragon does this, it will not bring any trouble to the king or the human race, right?"
"Hahaha..."
After hearing what the old Dragon King said, Di Xin suddenly looked up to the sky and laughed——
"The lonely king said: All the land in the world is the imperial land; the land beside the land is the imperial minister. The lonely king is the lord of the great wilderness. The lonely king manages the great wasteland. What does it have to do with Haotian? If he dares to come, since the lonely king dares to swing his sword against Nuwa, he will naturally dare to swing his sword against Haotian!"
Boom!
Click!
As Di Xin's voice sounded, thunder from the nine heavens instantly pierced the sky, and the shocked eyes of countless powerful people all looked in the direction of Chao Ge!
And at this time,
The Dragon King of the East China Sea completely surrendered to Di Xin's tyranny, lowered his head and clasped his fists, and said sincerely: "The Human Emperor is a great virtue, comparable to the three ancient emperors. The old dragon swears to humanity: As long as the old dragon lives for one day, the Human Emperor will obey his orders!"
"Okay!"
After hearing this, Di Xin was overjoyed and said: "But now there are frequent floods and droughts. In the next few days, the Dragon King will have to work hard!"
"Don't worry, Human Emperor, the old dragon will live up to his orders!"
After the Dragon King left ten words, he quickly left Chaoge with the Imperial Edict in hand and headed straight for Chentangguan.
It didn't forget that there was a Huang Feihu holding a mountain whip!
One day later,
Huang Feihu was ordered to return to Chaoge from Chentangguan, while the Dragon King of the East China Sea hurried back to the East China Sea.
"Brother, what happened? Why did our cultivation suddenly soar?"
"Yes, brother, and I, the dragon clan, have been burdened with two calamities of killing and calamity, but about half of them have been offset by supreme luck. What's going on?"
"Brother, could it be that the Heavenly Court knew that the Human Emperor wanted us to surrender, so it took action?!"
…
Just after returning to the East China Sea, the Dragon King of the West, South and North Seas surrounded the Dragon King of the East China Sea. You said something to me, wondering what happened.
"Haha, things are not what you think!"
Seeing that the three dragon kings were getting anxious, the Dragon King of the East China Sea laughed loudly and said loudly: "On behalf of the Dragon Clan, I have formed an alliance with the prehistoric human race. At the same time, I promised that the four seas will be merged into the prehistoric plate and come under the jurisdiction of the Human Emperor!"
Boom!
After hearing the words of the Dragon King of the East China Sea, the Dragon Kings of the West, South and North Seas were all stunned.
After a while, the Dragon King of the West Sea woke up from the shock and stammered: "Brother, what is going on?"
"It's like this. I first went to Chentangguan to meet King Wucheng of the Great Shang, and found Jili Gulu... You don't know that when I saw the power of humanity surrounding the human emperor, I was almost crushed to the point of showing my prototype. I have only seen that kind of scene in saints!"
The Dragon King of the East China Sea told his three younger brothers Chao Ge's line in detail, and then praised Di Xin severely.
And at this time,
The Dragon Kings of the West, South and North Seas were once again shocked and speechless!
Just then,
An extremely weak, but terrifying aura arose in the bloodline of the Dragon King of the Four Seas, suddenly enveloped them, and then an extremely weak voice sounded in their ears——
